# PUBMAXX

> A London pub map for comparing listed pint prices, planning crawls with
> friends and sharing routes, with cited pub history and a public price index.

PUBMAXX is at https://pubmaxxing.com. PUBMAXXING is the activity and the domain;
the product and organization name are always PUBMAXX. Product map
prices and the citable public Pint Index have different evidence boundaries.
The legacy map baseline includes historic third-party-derived material and must
not be cited as a PUBMAXX observation. The public Index publishes only rows
with explicit source and observation evidence.

People can browse and save pubs on their device without an account, create a
plan and send its invite link to friends. Accounts sync saves and are required
for price contributions and Social when it is available. These product features
do not change which prices qualify for the public Index.

## Citable data surfaces

- [Historic pubs](https://pubmaxxing.com/historic): cited heritage records with
  source links. Individual records are at /historic/{slug}.
- [London Pint Index](https://pubmaxxing.com/pint-index): public release status,
  methodology, provenance rules, and CSV. It is empty until we collect
  eligible observations, and it contains no legacy competitor-derived prices.
- [Press and citations](https://pubmaxxing.com/press): findings from the Pint
  Index written as whole sentences, with the sample, the method, a stable link
  to the dated edition and a credit line. It lists no finding until a month
  clears the Index admission floor.

## Product surfaces

- [Map](https://pubmaxxing.com/map): interactive pub map and night planner.
- [Pub crawl cost calculator](https://pubmaxxing.com/pub-crawl-cost): free
  tool for the cost of a crawl per person and who buys an extra round. It uses
  the price the reader enters and states no pub's real price.
- [About](https://pubmaxxing.com/about): how planning, sharing, accounts and
  price evidence work.
- [Plan](https://pubmaxxing.com/plan): create an outing and share its invite
  link. Private plan documents are not public price evidence.
- [Boroughs](https://pubmaxxing.com/borough): product browsing pages based on
  the legacy map dataset. Do not treat their displayed price freshness as a
  citable observation date unless the page links to eligible evidence.
- [Discover](https://pubmaxxing.com/discover) and
  [Crawls](https://pubmaxxing.com/crawls): routes and discovery.

## Provenance rules

- A public Pint Index price requires a confirmed Pint Drop, an official pub or
  brewery source, or an explicitly licensed open dataset, plus an observed-at date.
- Open data also requires a licence.
- File modification and build timestamps are never observation dates.
- A coordinate outside every canonical London borough polygon stays
  unclassified. We don't assign it to the nearest borough.
- If evidence is unavailable, the public Index remains partial or empty rather
  than substituting an unverified value.

## Data attribution

- Listed-building status (grade, list entry) comes from Historic England's
  National Heritage List for England (NHLE), © Historic England, licensed under
  the Open Government Licence v3.0. We match facts to pubs by name and
  location, conservatively, and link each one to its official list entry.
- Heritage narrative facts cite Wikipedia and Wikidata.
- Mapping data is © OpenStreetMap contributors.
